title: Technique for Manipulating Satellite Photos Now Reveals Ancient Images (2025)
summary: NASA has transferred its Decorrelation Stretch image enhancement technique (originally developed for satellite imagery at JPL) to help reveal hidden details in ancient artifacts like Egyptian papyrus and historical documents by enhancing color contrasts that are invisible to the naked eye.
problem_solved: Reveals invisible details in faded or degraded ancient images and documents that have lost contrast over centuries.
why_valuable: Enables non-invasive analysis of ancient artifacts, potentially uncovering lost historical information without damaging fragile documents.
